info.name: DanceSchoolApp v3
info.description:
FlowArtes / Ent'Artes Dance School API

## Setup

1. Select the **DanceSchoolApp** environment
    
2. Set `base_url` if needed (default: [https://localhost:7003](https://localhost:7003))
    
3. Run **POST Login** — the test script auto-saves `userId`, `roles`, and `expiresAt`
    
4. All requests use the shared cookie jar automatically (JWT is HttpOnly cookie)
    

## Test Users

| ID | Username | Email | Password |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | admin | [admin@admin.com](https://mailto:admin@admin.com) | 12345678 |
| 8 | staff | [staff@staff.com](https://mailto:staff@staff.com) | 12345678 |
| 10 | parent | [parent@parent.com](https://mailto:parent@parent.com) | 12345678 |
| 11 | coach | [coach@coach.com](https://mailto:coach@coach.com) | 12345678 |

Login accepts **email OR username** + password.

## Variables

- `base_url` — server base (change to switch between local/staging)
    
- `userId` — auto-set by Login
    
- `roles` — auto-set by Login
    
- `user_id`, `student_id`, `coach_id`, `class_id`, `participant_id`, `studio_id`, `modality_id`, `item_id` — set manually or auto-captured by POST scripts
    

## Enumerators

### CoachClass Status

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Requested | Parent created the class request |
| 1 | Approved | Coach accepted — class is live |
| 2 | Rejected | Rejected by staff or coach |
| 3 | Cancelled | Cancelled (was Requested or Approved) |
| 4 | Finished | End time passed — validation window open |
| 5 | Validated | Staff final sign-off complete |
| 6 | Pending | All validations done — awaiting staff |
| 7 | StaffApproved | Staff approved, awaiting coach acceptance |
| 8 | CoachApproved | All parents approved enrollment (coach-created flow) — awaiting staff sign-off |

### CoachClass ClassOrigin

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | ParentCreated | Parent requested an individual class — follows Staff→Coach approval flow |
| 1 | CoachCreated | Coach created group or individual class — parents approve enrollment first |

### ParentEnrollmentStatus (on Participant)

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | NotRequired | Parent-created class — no enrollment approval step |
| 1 | Pending | Coach-created class — parent has not yet responded |
| 2 | Approved | Parent approved the enrollment |
| 3 | Rejected | Parent rejected the enrollment |

### CoachClass Lifecycle Endpoints

**Parent-created flow:** `Requested(0) → StaffApproved(7) → [coach-respond] → Approved(1) → Finished(4) → Pending(6) → Validated(5)`

**Coach-created flow:** `Requested(0) → [parent-approve-enrollment per student] → CoachApproved(8) → [staff-respond] → Approved(1) → Finished(4) → Pending(6) → Validated(5)`

| Action | Endpoint | Body | Applies to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Parent create individual | `POST /api/coachclasses` | `{ coachId, modalityId, startDatetime, endDatetime, studentId }` | parent |
| Coach create group/individual | `POST /api/coachclasses/coach-create` | `{ modalityId, startDatetime, endDatetime, maxParticipants, studentIds[] }` | coach |
| Parent approve enrollment | `PATCH /api/participants/{id}/parent-approve-enrollment` | `{ "approve": bool }` | parent |
| Staff approve | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/staff-respond` | `{ "approve": true }` | staff |
| Staff reject | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/staff-respond` | `{ "approve": false, "reason"?: "..." }` | staff |
| Coach accept | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/coach-respond` | `{ "accept": true }` | coach (parent-created only) |
| Coach reject | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/coach-respond` | `{ "accept": false, "reason"?: "..." }` | coach (parent-created only) |
| Coach validate | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/coach-validate` | `{ "didTeach": true/false }` | coach |
| Staff final validate | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/staff-validate` | _(no body)_ | staff |
| Cancel | `PATCH /api/coachclasses/{id}/cancel` | _(no body)_ | staff |
| Finish | ⚙ **AUTOMATED** by ClassLifecycleWorker | No endpoint — polls every 5 min | — |

### StudentAcceptance Status

| Value | Name |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Pending |
| 1 | Accepted |
| 2 | Rejected |

### Roles

| Value | Name |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Admin |
| 1 | Staff |
| 2 | Coach |
| 3 | Parent |

### BlockedPeriod Scope

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Undefined | Fallback — do not use when creating |
| 1 | NormalClass | Regular school classes occupy studios |
| 2 | Studio | Specific studio is blocked |
| 3 | Coach | Specific coach is unavailable |
| 4 | Event | School event — may block everything |
| 5 | Holiday | School break / public holiday |

> When `scope=2` (Studio), `studioId` is **required**. When `scope=3` (Coach), `coachId` is **required**. 
  

### ItemRequisition Status

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Pending | Waiting for staff review |
| 1 | Approved | Staff approved, item reserved |
| 2 | Rejected | Staff rejected |
| 3 | Returned | Item returned |
| 4 | Cancelled | Cancelled by parent or staff |

### CoachValidation Status (on Participant)

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Pending | Parent hasn't responded yet |
| 1 | ParentConfirmed | Parent confirmed student attended |
| 2 | Disputed | Parent says student did not attend |

item.description:
Coach class lifecycle:
Requested(0) → StaffApproved(7) → Approved(1) → Finished(4) → Pending(6) → Validated(5)

Workflow:
1. Parent POSTs a class (Requested). Studio is auto-assigned.
2. Staff PATCH /staff-respond { approve: true } → StaffApproved. Coach notified.
   OR Staff PATCH /staff-respond { approve: false, reason? } → Rejected.
3. Coach PATCH /coach-respond { accept: true } → Approved. Parent + staff notified.
   OR Coach PATCH /coach-respond { accept: false, reason? } → Rejected.
4. Students join via Participants.
5. ⚙ ClassLifecycleWorker auto-transitions Approved → Finished when end time passes (polls every 5 min). NO manual endpoint.
6. Coach PATCH /coach-validate { didTeach: bool } to confirm they taught.
7. Parent PATCH participant/{id}/parent-validate { attended: bool } to confirm attendance.
8. Once all participants respond → class auto-moves to Pending.
9. Staff PATCH /staff-validate → Validated.

item.name: Full Class Lifecycle

request.description: Step 1: Staff logs in. JWT cookie is set automatically.

exec: pm.test("Step 2: Staff creates parent account", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

request.description: Step 2: Staff creates parent account. Welcome email with setup link is sent automatically.
Step 3: Parent logs in using the temporary password communicated by the school.
Step 4: Parent registers a student. Student starts as Pending(0) awaiting staff acceptance.
Step 5: Staff (re-login if needed) sees the pending student in the queue.
Step 6: Staff accepts the student. AcceptanceStatus → Accepted(1). Parent is notified.
Step 7: Parent browses free coach slots to pick a time for the class request.
Step 8: Parent requests a coaching session. Status → Requested(0). Studio auto-selected.
Step 9: Staff (re-login if needed) sees the new class request in the queue.

exec: console.log("→ StaffApproved(7). Coach has been notified.");

request.description: Step 10: Staff approves the class request (approve=true). Status → StaffApproved(7). Coach notified.

exec: console.log("→ Approved(1). Parent and staff notified.");

request.description: Step 11: Coach (login as coach first) accepts the class (accept=true). Status → Approved(1). Parent notified.
Step 12: Parent enrolls their student into the Approved class.

exec: pm.test("Step 13: Staff marks class finished", () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

request.description: Step 13: Staff marks the class as finished. Status → Finished(4). Dual-validation window opens.
Step 14: Coach (login as coach first) confirms they taught the class.

exec: console.log("Once all participants respond, class auto-moves to Pending(6).");

request.description: Step 15: Parent (login as parent first) confirms their student attended. When all participants respond, class auto-moves to Pending(6).
Step 16: Staff (re-login if needed) sees the class awaiting final sign-off in Pending(6).

exec: console.log("→ Validated(5). Terminal state. Class is billing-ready.");

request.description: Step 17: Staff gives final sign-off. Status → Validated(5). Class is now billing-ready.
Step 18: Staff checks billing — the newly validated class should appear in the monthly report.
